versions.content: The part <NAME> from [SWS_MemMap_00022] shall con- tain the following core scope keywords to indicate the restriction/qualifications: {coreScope} = • GLOBAL is code/data which can be executed/accessed by any core in case of multi-core ECUs. • LOCAL code/data must be mapped by the integrator to a specific core (Core 0, Core 1, ...) in case of multi-core ECUs. The {coreScope} tag can be considered optional in case it is GLOBAL . Means in case no {coreScope} keyword is added the default shall be treated as GLOBAL . Instead the {coreScope} tag LOCAL shall be considered as mandatory. Background: Scope of LOCAL SwAddrMethod is visible and can not be mixed up with GLOBAL SwAddrMethods.
